OrbisProxy is a lightweight, high-performance proxy written in Go (not Java).  
It is designed for reliability, scalability with built-in loadbalancing, player transfers, and plugin support.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "Installing required packages..."
apk add --no-cache ca-certificates wget

REPO="OrbisProxy/proxy"
BINARY_NAME="orbisproxy-linux"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"

echo "Installing OrbisProxy"
echo "Requested version: $VERSION"

if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  echo "Fetching latest release tag from GitHub..."

  TAG=$(wget -qO- "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name":[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')

  if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then
    echo "Failed to determine latest release tag"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  TAG="$VERSION"
fi

echo "Using release tag: $TAG"

DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$TAG/$BINARY_NAME"

echo "Downloading binary:"
echo "$DOWNLOAD_URL"

wget -O orbisproxy "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
chmod +x orbisproxy

echo "OrbisProxy installed successfully"
